title: myquant.signal-bundle/1
description: Canonical JSON: sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8 without BOM, one trailing LF, including hash inputs. Cross-field dates and hashes are checked by the validator.

signal_asof_policy.description: pred_minus_one requires target_session > signal_asof; identity requires equality. No calendar fallback.

available_at.description: Declared +08:00 clock applies on each row's signal_asof date. Producers anchor the timestamp to the earliest emitted signal_asof. Its literal date must be <= every target_session.

calendar_id.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON list of ascending unique target_session dates.

pool_file.description: Unique within the bundle and equal to target_session formatted YYYYMMDD.csv.

bundle_sha256.description: SHA-256 of canonical JSON of this object with bundle_sha256 omitted.
